# BCV Today

> Official Banco Central de Venezuela exchange rates (USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB against the bolívar), published as a static website and a free, read-only JSON API. Unofficial project, not affiliated with the bank.

The data comes from the rates the bank publishes on business days. No authentication is required: every endpoint is a public static JSON file served from GitHub Pages, so do not attempt OAuth/OIDC discovery or token exchange.

## Pages as Markdown

Every page is also available as Markdown: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`, or append `index.md` to its URL.

- [Home (Markdown)](https://bcv.today/index.md): today's official rates and FAQ
- [BCV dollar (Markdown)](https://bcv.today/dolar-bcv/index.md): USD/VES rate, quick conversions and the last 7 days
- [History (Markdown)](https://bcv.today/history/index.md): how the daily history is built
- [API documentation (Markdown)](https://bcv.today/api/index.md): endpoints, schema and examples
- [Integrations (Markdown)](https://bcv.today/en/integrations/index.md): every BCV Today product with links and setup snippets

## API

- [Latest rate](https://bcv.today/api/v1/rate.json): `GET /api/v1/rate.json`, the rate currently in effect
- [History index](https://bcv.today/api/v1/history.json): `GET /api/v1/history.json`, up to the latest 1830 daily entries
- [Rate for one day](https://bcv.today/api/v1/history/2026-01-02.json): `GET /api/v1/history/{YYYY-MM-DD}.json`, one calendar-day snapshot
- [API status](https://bcv.today/api/v1/status.json): `GET /api/v1/status.json`, freshness, effective date and supported currencies
- [API documentation](https://bcv.today/api/): endpoints, response schema and code examples
- [OpenAPI description](https://bcv.today/openapi.json): machine-readable description of the endpoints

## MCP server

- [BCV Today MCP server](https://mcp.bcv.today/mcp): remote Model Context Protocol endpoint (Streamable HTTP, stateless, no authentication) with the tools `get_latest_rates`, `get_rate_by_date`, `get_history`, `convert` and `get_status`
- [MCP server card](https://bcv.today/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): SEP-2127 server card with the endpoint, transport and tool list

## Client libraries and integrations

- [Integrations](https://bcv.today/en/integrations/): every BCV Today product in one page (JSON API, Python, JavaScript and PHP libraries, Odoo module, web widget, WooCommerce plugin, MCP server, A2A agent, Markdown, llms.txt, Telegram bot and channel); Spanish version at https://bcv.today/integraciones/
- [Python package `bcv`](https://pypi.org/project/bcv/): official zero-dependency Python client and `bcv` CLI (`pip install bcv`) with latest rates, rate on a date with weekend carry-forward, history and conversions
- [npm package `bcv-today`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bcv-today): official zero-dependency JavaScript/TypeScript client (`npm install bcv-today`; ESM + CommonJS, Node 18+, Deno, Bun, browsers, Cloudflare Workers) with exact decimal conversions, weekend carry-forward, history and the `bcv-today` CLI
- [PHP package `grupoclip/bcv-today`](https://packagist.org/packages/grupoclip/bcv-today): official zero-dependency PHP 8.1+ client (`composer require grupoclip/bcv-today`) with exact decimal conversions, weekend carry-forward, history and a Laravel service provider and facade
- [Go module `github.com/grupoclip/bcv-api/packages/go`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/grupoclip/bcv-api/packages/go): official standard-library-only Go client (`go get github.com/grupoclip/bcv-api/packages/go`) with exact decimal conversions, weekend carry-forward, history and the `bcv` CLI (`go install github.com/grupoclip/bcv-api/packages/go/cmd/bcv@latest`)
- [Odoo module `l10n_ve_bcv_rate`](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/l10n_ve_bcv_rate): free Odoo 16.0-20.0 module (Community and Enterprise, Odoo.sh or on-premise; not Odoo Online) that updates each company's currency rates daily with the official BCV rate from this API; source at https://github.com/grupoclip/odoo-bcv-rate (branches 16.0 to 20.0)

## A2A agent

- [BCV Today Rates Agent](https://mcp.bcv.today/a2a): Agent2Agent (A2A) JSON-RPC endpoint (protocol 1.0 and 0.3, stateless, no authentication). Send `SendMessage` (or 0.3 `message/send`) with text in Spanish or English ("convertir 100 USD a VES", "USD rate on 2026-01-04") or a DataPart such as `{"skill":"convert","amount":100,"from":"USD","to":"VES"}`; replies carry a text summary plus structured JSON. Skills: `latest-rates`, `rate-on-date`, `convert`, `history`, `status`
- [A2A agent card](https://bcv.today/.well-known/agent-card.json): AgentCard with `supportedInterfaces`, capabilities and skills (also served at https://mcp.bcv.today/.well-known/agent-card.json)

## Data notes

- Dates are ISO 8601 strings.
- `effective_date` is the official BCV validity date ("fecha valor"); `updated_at` is the UTC capture timestamp.
- On weekends and holidays, `effective_date` may point to the previous business day whose rate remains in effect.
- Older historical entries may omit currencies that were unavailable in the source data; currency fields are numeric when present.

## Discovery

- [API catalog](https://bcv.today/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset with docs, status and OpenAPI
- [Agent card](https://bcv.today/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A AgentCard of the rates agent at https://mcp.bcv.today/a2a
- [Agent Skills](https://bcv.today/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): skill index, including the `bcv-rates` skill
- [auth.md](https://bcv.today/auth.md): authentication notes for agents; no registration or credentials are needed
- [AI catalog](https://bcv.today/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD / ai-catalog manifest of the API, agent card, skills and docs
- [Personal Agent Protocol](https://bcv.today/.well-known/poppy.json): website-only Poppy discovery document, with no sign-in
- [Sitemap](https://bcv.today/sitemap.xml): every page of the site

- [Full agent context](https://bcv.today/llms-full.txt): the complete documentation in one plain-text file
